title: Vallee's journals: Pasulka told not to talk about hybrids

tellings.quote: You have the same thing with uh Valle's journals. He recounts a conversation with Diana Pasulka, where Pasulka is basically explaining that they I don't know. Tim Taylor, who is it? Is saying like, you shouldn't be talking about the hybrid thing.

plain: In his published journals, the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée describes a conversation with the religion scholar Diana Pasulka, who told him that a man named Timothy Taylor had warned her against talking about 'the hybrid thing', meaning the idea of human and alien hybrids. The researcher Jason Simosa recounts this from the journals, and he is unsure of the details as he tells it. He offers it as a sign that someone wanted the hybrid subject kept quiet.
